items.subject: Spanish couples of the early 1960s, men in dark suits and women in full-skirted dresses, among them a slim Spanish man in his late twenties and a Spanish woman in her mid-twenties
items.action: couples circle the parquet in a slow dance as the young pair meet for the first time near the edge of the floor
items.gaze_interaction: most dancers read as silhouettes from behind; the young pair turn toward each other, heads slightly inclined
items.setting: grand ballroom of the Círculo de Bellas Artes, Madrid, 1961, tall mirrored walls, gilded mouldings, crystal chandeliers
items.color_palette: warm gold, ivory, deep burgundy, polished walnut parquet
items.props_detail: a small dance orchestra on a low stage with brass instruments glinting
items.camera_angle: slightly high angle from a balcony
items.lighting: warm chandelier light with soft evening glow
items.mood: gentle golden glow, unhurried bodies, relaxed shoulders, soft haze of evening
items.narration_anchor: Dieciséis de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y uno. En el salón de baile del Círculo de Bellas Artes de Madrid, Daniel Écija conoce a María Bernal.

items.subject: a newly married Spanish couple, the man late twenties in a dark suit, the woman mid-twenties in a modest white dress and veil, a few relatives behind
items.action: the couple step down the stone stairs of a Madrid parish church after the ceremony
items.gaze_interaction: the pair seen at mid-distance, arm in arm, looking down at the steps; relatives seen from behind
items.setting: plain stone parish church facade in a working-class Madrid street, September 1962, cobbles and iron balconies
items.color_palette: sun-bleached limestone, white, charcoal suits, faded ochre plaster
items.props_detail: scattered rice grains on the stone steps
items.mood: mild September light, relatives' arms raised, unhurried pace down the steps
items.narration_anchor: Un año después se casan: el jueves veinte de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y dos.

items.subject: hundreds of Spanish emigrants, men in work jackets and caps, women in headscarves and cotton dresses, filling the frame along the rails
items.action: emigrants crowd the decks and gangway of a large 1960s passenger liner preparing to sail for Australia
items.gaze_interaction: most figures read from behind facing the sea; a few at the rail turn back toward the quay
items.setting: Spanish harbour quay, 1962, a white-hulled passenger liner with a single funnel, cranes and cargo nets
items.color_palette: white hull, rust-streaked steel, navy blue water, sun-faded clothing in browns and greys
items.props_detail: stacks of cardboard suitcases tied with cord on the quay
items.camera_angle: low angle from the quay toward the hull
items.mood: crowded rails, shoulders pressed together, hats held against the harbour wind
items.narration_anchor: Cuatro días más tarde ya están en el barco. Van a Australia con el acuerdo migratorio por el que pasaron cerca de ocho mil españoles.

items.subject: a young Spanish couple, the man in his late twenties in a plain shirt, the woman in her mid-twenties in a cotton dress
items.action: the pair stand together at the stern rail as the open sea stretches empty ahead
items.gaze_interaction: seen from behind, both looking out toward the blank horizon
items.setting: stern deck of a 1960s emigrant liner, wooden deck planks, coiled ropes, white wake trailing
items.color_palette: deep ocean blue, pale sky, weathered teak, white paint
items.props_detail: a single shared cardboard suitcase at their feet
items.mood: vast empty horizon, two small figures close, wind pulling at clothes
items.narration_anchor: De Wittenoom no saben nada; saben que hay trabajo y que van juntos.

items.subject: a Spanish woman in her mid-twenties in a simple cotton dress and cardigan, beside a slim Spanish man in his late twenties
items.action: she walks pressed tightly against her husband's side along the deck, arm hooked through his
items.gaze_interaction: faces toward the camera, her head leaning on his shoulder, his eyes ahead to the sea
items.setting: promenade deck of an emigrant liner, 1962, lifeboats overhead, painted railings
items.color_palette: faded blue cotton, white steel, sea grey, warm skin tones
items.props_detail: a small leather handbag clutched against her chest
items.mood: bodies close, small steps matched to his, soft grey light on the water
items.narration_anchor: «Iba pegadita a mi marido, como una niña», recuerda su mujer.

items.subject: two young Spanish couples from Madrid, men in rolled-sleeve work shirts, women in sun-faded cotton dresses
items.action: the couples share an evening meal around a small table outside a corrugated iron house
items.gaze_interaction: figures turned toward each other in conversation, faces partly in shade
items.setting: front porch of a modest miners' house in Wittenoom, 1962, red earth yard, iron roof
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, faded green paint, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: an enamel coffee pot and glasses on an oilcloth-covered table
items.mood: long shadows, chairs pulled close, relaxed postures in dusty air
items.narration_anchor: Con el tiempo se hicieron amigos íntimos de otra pareja, Milagros Barroso y Ramón de Juan. Esa familia madrileña había hecho el mismo viaje un mes antes.

items.subject: a Spanish boy of about eight in shorts and a sweat-damp cotton shirt
items.action: the boy sits in the narrow shade of a lifeboat on a sweltering deck
items.gaze_interaction: small figure seen from a distance, head tipped back, shirt clinging, looking at the white sky
items.setting: open deck of an emigrant liner in tropical waters, 1962, hot steel and tarred planks
items.color_palette: bleached white, hot steel grey, pale sky, faded khaki
items.props_detail: a tin cup of water beside him on the planks
items.camera_angle: high angle from an upper deck
items.mood: glaring heat shimmer, slumped small body, hard short shadows
items.narration_anchor: Un niño que hizo ese viaje todavía recuerda el calor.

items.subject: a Spanish boy of about eight in short trousers and a buttoned shirt, among his Spanish family, parents in their thirties
items.action: the boy climbs the steep gangway onto the liner, hand held by his mother
items.gaze_interaction: the boy glances up at the towering hull; family read from behind
items.setting: Málaga harbour quay, 1962, passenger liner hull rising above, bollards and mooring ropes
items.color_palette: white hull, Mediterranean blue, sandy stone, faded cotton colours
items.props_detail: a battered cardboard suitcase carried by the father
items.mood: towering hull dwarfing small figures, cautious steps on the gangway
items.narration_anchor: Víctor Calvo era un niño cuando subió a ese barco.

items.subject: a 1960s white passenger liner carrying emigrants
items.action: the liner pulls away from the Málaga breakwater toward open sea
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction toward the departing ship and the widening gap of water
items.setting: Málaga harbour, 1962, lighthouse on the breakwater, city and hills behind
items.color_palette: Mediterranean blue, white hull, ochre city walls, hazy hills
items.props_detail: a trail of dark funnel smoke drifting over the harbour
items.camera_angle: high angle from the hills above the port
items.mood: widening stretch of water, small ship on a vast sea, calm haze
items.narration_anchor: «Salimos de Málaga y tardamos más de 20 días en llegar en barco a Australia», dice Calvo.

items.subject: an emigrant liner with passengers crowded at the rails
items.action: the ship moves slowly through the narrow canal between flat desert banks
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction along the straight canal toward a shimmering horizon; passengers seen as distant silhouettes fanning themselves
items.setting: Suez Canal, 1962, sand banks, palms and a low signal station
items.color_palette: pale sand, bleached sky, turquoise canal water, white hull
items.props_detail: heat haze rising off the sand banks
items.camera_angle: high angle from the canal bank
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, telephoto compression
items.mood: shimmering heat waves, figures slumped against rails, no shade anywhere
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda el canal de Suez y el calor que hacía ahí, un calor que todavía lo hace resoplar cuando lo cuenta.

items.subject: a Spanish family below deck, a mother in her thirties, a father in his thirties and a boy of about eight
items.action: the family lie and sit pale on narrow bunks as the cabin rolls with the swell
items.gaze_interaction: the mother sits hunched on a bunk edge, head lowered; the boy curled on his side; the father turned toward the porthole
items.setting: cramped third-class cabin of a 1960s liner, steel bunks, riveted walls
items.color_palette: dull green paint, grey steel, faded blankets, dim yellow
items.props_detail: a swaying enamel basin on the floor
items.camera_angle: slightly high angle from the doorway
items.lighting: single dim bulb and grey porthole light
items.mood: tilted horizon in the porthole, slumped bodies, sweat-damp hair, stale dim light
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda los mareos. Y la incertidumbre: no saber muy bien adónde iban ni cómo iban a vivir.

items.subject: a small twin-engine propeller airliner of the early 1960s
items.action: the plane bucks through hot turbulent air low over the outback
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction following the aircraft across an endless red landscape
items.setting: sky above the Pilbara, Western Australia, 1962, red ranges and spinifex below
items.color_palette: deep red earth, ochre ridges, dusty pale blue sky, silver fuselage
items.mood: tilted wings, heat haze, tiny aircraft over vast empty land
items.narration_anchor: Después del barco, un avión pequeño, de hélices, que se sacude durante todo el vuelo.

items.subject: a small propeller plane and newly arrived Spanish families, men in jackets, women in cotton dresses, children
items.action: the plane rolls to a stop on a dirt airstrip, raising a red dust cloud as passengers step down
items.gaze_interaction: figures seen from behind and in silhouette, arms raised against the dust
items.setting: Wittenoom airstrip in the red Pilbara desert, 1962, surfaced with pale grey-blue mine tailings, iron ranges beyond
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, grey-blue tailings, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a windsock hanging limp on a pole beside the strip
items.mood: billowing dust swallowing small figures, squinting heads bowed, glaring light
items.narration_anchor: Aterriza en una pista en medio de una tierra muy roja, en el desierto de Pilbara, en Australia Occidental. Hay polvo por todas partes.

items.subject: a Spanish boy of about eight and his family carrying suitcases, among rows of small mining houses
items.action: the family walk along a dusty street toward newly assigned houses
items.gaze_interaction: the boy turns his head toward the dust drifting between the houses; family seen from behind
items.setting: Wittenoom residential street, 1962, active town, low houses of corrugated iron, timber and asbestos cement sheeting, street surfaced with grey-blue tailings
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, weathered grey cement sheet, faded paint, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: fine dust coating the corrugated iron walls
items.mood: dust hanging in the air, shoes and hems powdered, harsh light on bare walls
items.narration_anchor: Ese niño cuenta que nunca había visto tanto polvo. Los llevan a las casas: chapa, madera y uralita.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings beside the mine gorge, distant miners in dusty workwear
items.action: a truck tips fresh blue asbestos tailings onto a spreading dump below the mill
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction toward the dumped tailings; tiny miners seen as silhouettes against the gorge
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge mine and mill, 1962, red iron cliffs, conveyor and corrugated sheds
items.color_palette: red cliffs, blue-grey tailings, ochre dust, rusted iron
items.camera_angle: high angle from the gorge rim
items.mood: drifting pale dust, workers small against red cliffs, glaring heat
items.narration_anchor: De esa tierra sacan crocidolita, el asbesto azul, un mineral que se paga bien porque aguanta el calor y no se gasta.

items.subject: a Spanish boy of about eight in dusty shorts, and his Spanish mother in her thirties in a faded house dress
items.action: the boy kneels in the yard, scooping pale blue-grey dust while his mother hangs laundry nearby
items.gaze_interaction: the boy looks down at the dust sifting through his fingers; the mother turned toward the washing line
items.setting: backyard of a corrugated iron house in Wittenoom, 1962, yard surfaced with blue asbestos tailings, fibro fence
items.color_palette: grey-blue dust, red earth, white laundry, faded iron
items.props_detail: white sheets on the line dusted with a fine grey film
items.mood: fine dust suspended in sunlight, unguarded play, ordinary chores, still air
items.narration_anchor: Nadie les dijo qué era el polvo. La compañía lo sabía desde hacía dieciocho años.
